judgment_text:
Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 439(2) of CrPC, seeking to cancel the anticipatory bail granted to the accused/2nd respondent, vide order dated 15-2-2023 passed by this Court in Crl.M.P. No. 3361 of 2023.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

A.D. Jagadish Chandira, J.:— When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner sought permission of this Court to withdraw this petition with liberty to file a fresh application. An endorsement to the said effect was also made by the learned counsel for the petitioner in the petition today.

2. In view of the above, this criminal original petition stands dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to work out her remedy in the manner known to law, if so advised.
